title: Make asks/ the one place every lane posts questions for you (CONTROL amendment)
detail: Lanes write "Tim must decide" in six different ways inside receipts today, so the Needs you page has to guess. This amendment tells every lane: when you need Tim, create one file in forge-coordination asks/open/ (format in asks/README.md) in the same run, and keep writing NEXT_OWNER in the receipt as now. CONTROL changes only on your instruction.
blocks: Completeness of the Needs you page.
action: Answer in chat with the option you want; Claude records it in asks/resolved/.
